'''Fruit of the Future''' (Indonesian: '''Mirai no Kajitsu – Buah Masa Depan''') is the Indonesian ending theme song for ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. It was performed by {{wp|JKT48}}. It is a cover of the Japanese song '''{{wp|Boku no Taiyō|Fruit of the Future}}''' (Japanese: '''未来の果実''' ''Mirai no Kajitsu'') by their sister group, {{wp|AKB48}}.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20131027204532id_/http://www.t-joy.net/images/up/news/1381888901131015_poketmonster_indonesia_release_EngFinal2.pdf Pokémon the Movie on theater at Indonesia for the first time ever! | T･JOY (archived)]</ref>
